root_cause.mechanism: Every guard-eligible parent disagreement synchronously launches one greedy and one lookahead rollout. Each rollout can consume the remaining full interaction budget and recomputes E_FULL_GEOMETRY at every branch step.
root_cause.timeout_confound: The v1 episode and replicate deadlines include both parent execution and diagnostic paired rollouts. A timeout can therefore be caused by measurement work rather than the closed-loop candidate trajectory.
root_cause.consequence_for_v1: The frozen selection remains mechanically gate_disabled, but the 2116 algorithm_timeout labels cannot all be interpreted as clean algorithm-performance failures. They are confounded by instrumentation cost.
root_cause.confidence_gate_finding: The gate code is active: margin_000 executed nine overrides. On this development case those overrides changed a goal-reaching 21-step parent into a 40-step budget exhaustion. margin_040 remained behaviorally identical to disabled because all observed margins were below 0.40.

required_v2_boundary.stage_a: Collect or sample paired branch evidence under a separately bounded instrumentation contract and never score its wall time as parent algorithm timeout.
required_v2_boundary.stage_b: Run closed-loop candidate policies without synchronous paired rollouts; time and score only the parent trajectory while retaining observed, guard-eligible, and executed-override counts.
required_v2_boundary.governance: Changing this timeout and measurement contract requires a new versioned instance, new development pilot, and new authorization. Verification and protected holdout remain closed.
